# Ship Kit

> A Claude Code plugin that runs an indie maker's launch. It reads your repo and live site. Then it writes what a launch needs: a scored pre-flight check, a landing page, posts in your voice checked against each platform's rules, a dated run sheet and a recap. It never posts for you.

## Commands

- /shipkit:check (free): a scored launch pre-flight of the repo and live site, with the evidence and the fix for each item.
- /shipkit:page (free): a one-file landing page from the repo, with the share image, llms.txt and sitemap.
- /shipkit:lint (free): checks any launch post with a linter for AI tells, an independent critic and the target platform's dated rules.
- /shipkit:posts (Pro): X, Reddit, Show HN, Product Hunt, directory and personal-message drafts in the maker's voice.
- /shipkit:seo (Pro): one keyword-researched page a week, with a QA pass.
- /shipkit:launch (Pro): all of the above plus a dated run sheet, UTM links, a directory plan, a tracker and a launch kit page.
- /shipkit:recap (Pro): launch totals from the tracker, listing checks, a results post and a receipts card image.
- /shipkit:outreach (Pro): finds up to 20 real people from their recent public posts and writes one personal message and follow-up for each. The maker sends them.
- /shipkit:today (Pro): the launch morning brief: what goes out today, at what time, with every word ready to paste.

## Launch Check (free web tool)

https://shipkit.tech/check: paste a URL and get a 0–100 launch score in about 10 seconds. It checks the share preview image and X card, title and description, a visible price, a way to try or buy, noindex, robots.txt rules for search and AI bots, the phone viewport, analytics, a custom domain and a contact link, with a fix for each problem. No sign-up.

## Price

Free edition: MIT licensed on GitHub. Pro: one payment of $9 for the first 25 copies, then $19 for the next 50, then $29. Studio: $69 for five people. 14-day refund.

## Requirements

Claude Code on any plan and Node 18 or newer. No other paid services.
